title: calea scabra var. longifolia
intro: Calea scabra var. longifolia, commonly known as Mexican Damiana, is a plant species native to the Americas. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as an anxiolytic and sedative, making it a potential treatment for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents present in Mexican Damiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Additionally, the plant has been used to treat symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and vaginal dryness, due to its estrogenic activity.
